note: Sign messages for the demo (works: a lane closure on part of La Trobe Street). Each message × 4 personas = a request to precompute; used to generate public/answers/demo.json. Road names follow apps/roads/public/cbd/network.json. read_s is an assumption: a VMS at 40 km/h, legible for about 100 m ≈ 9 s, a static sign ≈ 3 s; the engine computes the real value from the equipment and speed
